lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਮਰਨੇ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: aise marane jo marai bahur na maranaa hoi ||29||
lines.translation: Let those who die, die such a death, that they shall never have to die again. ||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਬਾਰੈ ਬਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer maanas janam dula(n)bh hai hoi na baarai baar ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, it is so difficult to obtain this human body; it does not just come over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਕੇ ਭੁਇ ਗਿਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਡਾਰ ॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: jiu ban phal paake bhui girahi bahur na laagahi daar ||30||
lines.translation: It is like the ripe fruit on the tree; when it falls to the ground, it cannot be re-attached to the branch. ||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤੂ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeeraa tuhee kabeer too tero naau kabeer ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, you are Kabeer; your name means great.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਬ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਤਜਹਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam ratan tab paaeeai jau pahile tajahi sareer ||31||
lines.translation: O Lord, You are Kabeer. The Jewel of the Lord is obtained, when the mortal first gives up his body. ||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਝੰਖੁ ਨ ਝੰਖੀਐ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jha(n)kh na jha(n)kheeai tumaro kahio na hoi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, do not struggle in stubborn pride; nothing happens just because you say so.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰੀਮ ਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: karam kareem j kar rahe met na saakai koi ||32||
lines.translation: No one can erase the actions of the Merciful Lord. ||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਝੂਠਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer kasautee raam kee jhoothaa tikai na koi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, no one who is false can withstand the Touchstone of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਸੋ ਸਹੈ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: raam kasautee so sahai jo mar jeevaa hoi ||33||
lines.translation: He alone can pass the test of the Lord's Touchstone, who remains dead while yet alive. ||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਊਜਲ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਕਾਪਰੇ ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer oojal pahirahi kaapare paan supaaree khaahi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, some wear gaudy robes, and chew betel leaves and betel nuts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: ekas har ke naam bin baadhe jam pur jaa(n)hi ||34||
lines.translation: Without the Name of the One Lord, they are bound and gagged and taken to the City of Death. ||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬੇੜਾ ਜਰਜਰਾ ਫੂਟੇ ਛੇਂਕ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer beRaa jarajaraa phoote chhe(n)k hajaar ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the boat is old, and it has thousands of holes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰੂਏ ਹਰੂਏ ਤਿਰਿ ਗਏ ਡੂਬੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰ ॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: harooe harooe tir gae doobe jin sir bhaar ||35||
lines.translation: Those who are light get across, while those who carry the weight of their sins on their heads are drowned. ||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਾਡ ਜਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਲਾਕਰੀ ਕੇਸ ਜਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਘਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer haad jare jiu laakaree kes jare jiu ghaas ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the bones burn like wood, and the hair burns like straw.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਰਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਇਓ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jag jarataa dekh kai bhaio kabeer udaas ||36||
lines.translation: Seeing the world burning like this, Kabeer has become sad. ||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਚਾਮ ਲਪੇਟੇ ਹਾਡ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer garab na keejeeai chaam lapete haad ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, do not be so proud of your bones wrapped up in skin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈਵਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਤਰ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਰਨੀ ਗਾਡ ॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: haivar oopar chhatr tar te phun dharanee gaad ||37||
lines.translation: Those who were on their horses and under their canopies, were eventually buried under the ground. ||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਊਚਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer garab na keejeeai oochaa dekh avaas ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, do not be so proud of your tall mansions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲੑਿ ਭੁਇ ਲੇਟਣਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਾਮੈ ਘਾਸੁ ॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: aaj kaalhi bhui letanaa oopar jaamai ghaas ||38||
lines.translation: Today or tomorrow, you shall lie beneath the ground, and the grass shall grow above you. ||38||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਰੰਕੁ ਨ ਹਸੀਐ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer garab na keejeeai ra(n)k na haseeai koi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, do not be so proud, and do not laugh at the poor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਹੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਉ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: ajahu s naau samu(n)dr mahi kiaa jaanau kiaa hoi ||39||
lines.translation: Your boat is still out at sea; who knows what will happen? ||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਰੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer garab na keejeeai dehee dekh sura(n)g ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, do not be so proud, looking at your beautiful body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲੑਿ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਹੁਗੇ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਂਚੁਰੀ ਭੁਯੰਗ ॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: aaj kaalhi taj jaahuge jiu kaa(n)churee bhuya(n)g ||40||
lines.translation: Today or tomorrow, you will have to leave it behind, like the snake shedding its skin. ||40||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਲੂਟਨਾ ਹੈ ਤ ਲੂਟਿ ਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹੈ ਲੂਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer lootanaa hai ta loot lai raam naam hai loot ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, if you must rob and plunder, then plunder the plunder of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਹੁਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜਾਹਿੰਗੇ ਛੂਟਿ ॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: phir paachhai pachhutaahuge praan jaahi(n)ge chhoot ||41||
lines.translation: Otherwise, in the world hereafter, you will regret and repent, when the breath of life leaves the body. ||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਨਮਿਓ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਵੈ ਆਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisaa koee na janamio apanai ghar laavai aag ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, there is no one born, who burns his own home,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚਉ ਲਰਿਕਾ ਜਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: paa(n)chau larikaa jaar kai rahai raam liv laag ||42||
lines.translation: and burning his five sons, remains lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਹੈ ਲਰਿਕਾ ਬੇਚਈ ਲਰਿਕੀ ਬੇਚੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ko hai larikaa bechaee larikee bechai koi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, how rare are those who sell their son and sell their daughter

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਝਾ ਕਰੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਜੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: saajhaa karai kabeer siu har sa(n)g banaj karei ||43||
lines.translation: and, entering into partnership with Kabeer, deal with the Lord. ||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀ ਮਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ih chetaavanee mat sahasaa rahi jaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, let me remind you of this. Do not be skeptical or cynical.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਭੋਗ ਜੁ ਭੋਗਵੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਗੁੜੁ ਲੈ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: paachhai bhog j bhogave tin ko guR lai khaahi ||44||
lines.translation: Those pleasures which you enjoyed so much in the past - now you must eat their fruits. ||44||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪੜਿਬੋ ਭਲੋ ਪੜਿਬੇ ਸਿਉ ਭਲ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer mai jaanio paRibo bhalo paRibe siu bhal jog ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, at first, I thought learning was good; then I thought Yoga was better.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਛਾਡਉ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੪੫॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat na chhaadau raam kee bhaavai ni(n)dau log ||45||
lines.translation: I shall never abandon devotional worship of the Lord, even though people may slander me. ||45||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਲੋਗੁ ਕਿ ਨਿੰਦੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer log k ni(n)dai bapuRaa jih man naahee giaan ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, how can the wretched people slander me? They have no wisdom or intelligence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਵਰ ਤਜੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ॥੪੬॥
lines.transliteration: raam kabeeraa rav rahe avar taje sabh kaam ||46||
lines.translation: Kabeer continues to dwell upon the Lord's Name; I have abandoned all other affairs. ||46||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਕੈ ਘਾਘਰੈ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer paradesee kai ghaagharai chahu dis laagee aag ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the robe of the stranger-soul has caught fire on all four sides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਜਲਿ ਕੋਇਲਾ ਭਈ ਤਾਗੇ ਆਂਚ ਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੪੭॥
lines.transliteration: khi(n)thaa jal koilaa bhaee taage aa(n)ch na laag ||47||
lines.translation: The cloth of the body has been burnt and reduced to charcoal, but the fire did not touch the thread of the soul. ||47||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਜਲਿ ਕੋਇਲਾ ਭਈ ਖਾਪਰੁ ਫੂਟ ਮਫੂਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer khi(n)thaa jal koilaa bhaee khaapar phoot maphoot ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the cloth has been burnt and reduced to charcoal, and the begging bowl is shattered into pieces.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਖੇਲਿਓ ਆਸਨਿ ਰਹੀ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ॥੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: jogee bapuRaa khelio aasan rahee bibhoot ||48||
lines.translation: The poor Yogi has played out his game; only ashes remain on his seat. ||48||
